definitions.full: H5489. Suph II. סוּף proper name, of a location (si vera lectio) named in defining location of Deuteronomic law-giving Deut 1:1 ( סוּף מול , where מוֺל by dissimil. for מוּל ); but read perhaps סוּף מִיַּם ( ᵐ5 πλησίον ρῆς ἐρυθρᾶς , ᵐ5 L + θαλάσσης , ᵑ9 contra mare rubrum ), see I. סוּף .
